blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Without any questions from lawmakers, the Senate terminated the period of interpellation on the proposed P785.2-million budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP). Vice President Sara Duterte personally attended the Senate session as the chamber tackled the OVP’s budget in plenary on Thursday. READ: Sara Duterte arrives at Senate amid OVP’s 2027 budget deliberations At 1:05 p.m., Senate Majority Leader Juan Miguel Zubiri moved for the plenary consideration of the OVP’s budget.
